svg.title: Choose which notifications reach you, kind by kind — SoftTrack web design mockup (#263)
svg.desc: Notification settings hold one switch, for email. As the kinds of notification grow, a grid sets each kind against each channel, with being assigned and being mentioned staying on in the app, a way to mute a team, and defaults that are exactly what happens today.

You are told when a ticket is assigned to you, when someone
mentions you, and when a ticket you are watching gets a
comment or changes status. You watch a ticket automatically
once you create it, comment on it, or are assigned it — and
the Watch button on any ticket overrides that either way.
